question: The diagram shows a set of equipotential surfaces for a system of charges. At which point (A, B, or C) is the electric field magnitude the strongest? Analyze the diagram to justify your answer.

options.A: Point A, because equipotential lines are closest there.
options.B: Point B, because it is located on the $40 \text{ V}$ equipotential surface.
options.C: Point C, because the equipotential surfaces are closest together there, indicating the strongest electric field.
options.D: The field is the same everywhere in the region.
